title: MedFamily
shortDescription: A secure, mobile-first healthcare PWA for family care coordination, medical records, prescriptions, reminders, appointments, and medicine orders.
longDescription: MedFamily is a Vercel-deployed healthcare Progressive Web App built for SEPM review and real-world deployment readiness. It gives patients and family admins a calm care command center for records, prescriptions, medicine reminders, appointments, vitals, consent-based access control, emergency summaries, notifications, and medicine orders. Doctors, hospitals, caretakers, and chemists get role-aware dashboards backed by Supabase Auth, Postgres, RLS, Storage, and Realtime. Medical content is presented as informational only and not as a diagnostic substitute.
